gloss_en: What are IFC and openBIM, and why should Korea adopt international standards?
question_paraphrase: IFC와 openBIM이 뭐고 왜 국제표준을 도입해야 하나
phrasing_notes: formal institutional register; English terms IFC/openBIM/bSI mixed in
answer_summary: IFC is the neutral ISO 16739 format; openBIM is vendor-neutral workflow; association advocates government-certified, privately developed standards.

gloss_en: bSK R&D center: IFC 4.3.2, IDS, validation service, certification, Korean owner BIM guidelines (MOLIT, KEC, KR, LH, PPS), open BIM design automation research
question_paraphrase: IFC 최신 버전, IDS, IFC 검증 서비스, 인증 스코어카드, 국내 BIM 지침 목록
answer_summary: Lists IFC 2x3/4/4.3, IDS, buildingSMART validation, scorecard certification, MOLIT/LH/PPS guidelines, Open BIM research group kbims.or.kr.

gloss_en: MOLIT architectural BIM application guide (2010) hosted by bSK
phrasing_notes: document title only (seen as a link in the site listing)
answer_summary: Early national guide on BIM application in architecture; classic reference for Korean BIM deliverables.

gloss_en: PPS (Public Procurement Service) facility project BIM application guideline v2.0
title_original: 조달청 시설사업 BIM 적용 지침서 V2.0
phrasing_notes: document title only (seen as a link in the site listing)
answer_summary: Procurement agency basic BIM guideline for public facility projects; defines deliverables for BIM-based tenders.

gloss_en: Seminar on current state and activation of BIM standardization (Korea Engineering Association, 11 Nov 2026)
title_original: BIM 표준화 현황 및 활성화 세미나 안내
answer_summary: Event notice on BIM standardization status in Korea.

gloss_en: ArchiCAD 30 official launch event invitation relayed by bSK
answer_summary: Shows ArchiCAD is a local BIM tool featured by bSK.

gloss_en: bSK BIM certification exam info page
Count proxies and their source categories
prompt: 이 ifc에 IfcBuildingElementProxy 몇 개야? 레빗 카테고리별로 나눠줘
expected_behavior: Count IfcBuildingElementProxy, group by Revit category/ObjectType property, report.

prompt: 레빗에서 내보낸 ifc인데 공유 매개변수가 속성에 하나도 안 보여. 어떤 객체에 Pset이 비어있는지 확인해줘
expected_behavior: List elements lacking custom Psets, compare with expected shared parameters, suggest enabling export of user-defined property sets.

prompt: 발주처 BIM 지침 기준으로 층/공간/부재 분류 누락된 거 있나 체크해줘
expected_behavior: Check IfcBuildingStorey/IfcSpace presence and classification on elements; report gaps; state which guideline assumptions were used.

prompt: 층 목록이랑 레벨 높이 뽑아줘 (mm 단위로)
expected_behavior: List IfcBuildingStorey names and elevations converted to mm.

prompt: ifc 파일 열면 아무것도 안 보이는데 왜 이래요? 용량은 200MB
expected_behavior: Check header, geometry presence, units, far-from-origin coordinates; suggest causes.

prompt: 층별 콘크리트 물량 m3로 정리해줘 슬래브 벽 기둥 따로
expected_behavior: Sum NetVolume/GrossVolume by storey and class, flag elements without quantities.

prompt: proxy로 나온 것 중 이름에 '기둥' 들어간거 IfcColumn으로 바꿔줘
expected_behavior: Find proxies by Name match, change class to IfcColumn, preserve psets, report count.

prompt: 레빗 ifc 내보내기 하면 좌표가 이상하게 멀리 가는데 공유좌표 설정 어떻게 해야해?
expected_behavior: Explain Shared Coordinates / Project Base Point vs Survey Point and IFC export site placement options.

prompt: 어제 올린 ifc랑 오늘 거 비교해서 추가/삭제/변경된 부재 알려줘
expected_behavior: Match by GlobalId, report added/removed/changed elements and property diffs.

prompt: 덕트 중에 시스템 지정 안된거 있나 봐줘
expected_behavior: Check IfcDuctSegment membership in systems, list unassigned.

prompt: ifcopenshell로 벽 이름이랑 면적 엑셀로 뽑는 코드 짜줘
expected_behavior: Provide IfcOpenShell script iterating IfcWall, reading Qto_WallBaseQuantities, writing CSV.

prompt: 재료 안 붙은 구조부재 리스트 줘
expected_behavior: List structural elements with no material association.

prompt: 실별 면적표 만들어줘 실명 번호 면적
expected_behavior: Extract IfcSpace LongName/Number and area quantities into a table.

gloss_en: Korean text garbled and import slow
prompt: ifc 레빗으로 링크하니까 한글이 깨지고 너무 느려요 ㅠㅠ
expected_behavior: Discuss Korean text encoding in IFC (\X2\ escapes), link vs open, file size reduction.

prompt: IDS 파일 기준으로 이 모델 검증하고 실패한 객체 알려줘
expected_behavior: Run IDS validation and list failing elements per specification.
